command: set -e; test -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb start-server >/dev/null; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; test -n "$serial"; model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d "\r")"; test "$model" = "SM-S906B"; echo DEVICE_OK=$serial:$model
